description: Archive: show status at session start; keep an exact copy before compaction and when a session ends.

hooks.command: node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/archive.mjs" session-start || echo "{\"systemMessage\":\"🟠 Archive Free needs Node.js 22.13 or newer, and node was not found.
